title: 2304. Minimum Path Cost in a Grid

examples.explanation: The path with the minimum possible cost is the path 5 -> 0 -> 1. - The sum of the values of cells visited is 5 + 0 + 1 = 6. - The cost of moving from 5 to 0 is 3. - The cost of moving from 0 to 1 is 8. So the total cost of the path is 6 + 3 + 8 = 17.
The path with the minimum possible cost is the path 2 -> 3. - The sum of the values of cells visited is 2 + 3 = 5. - The cost of moving from 2 to 3 is 1. So the total cost of this path is 5 + 1 = 6.
